map.Plank 方程：t = (ρ λ / (T_f − T∞)) × (P·d /: Plank equation: t = (ρ λ / (T_f − T∞)) × (P·d / h + R·d² / k). Shape factors: slab P=1/2, R=1/8; cylinder P=1/4, R=1/16; sphere P=1/6, R=1/24. This covers the phase-change freezing time only, without pre-cooling or supercooling. Quick freezing requires passing the −1 to −5°C maximum ice crystal zone in under 30 minutes.

map.相变冻结时间 t = (ρ·L/ΔT)·(P·d/h + R·d²/k)，ΔT=: Phase-change freezing time t = (ρ·L/ΔT)·(P·d/h + R·d²/k), with ΔT = initial food temperature minus refrigerant temperature and P, R the shape factors (slab 0.5/0.125, cylinder 0.25/0.0625, sphere 1/6/1/24).
map.50 mm 厚板状食材、初温 −1.5℃、介质 −35℃（h=50 W/m²K、: For a 50mm-thick slab starting at −1.5°C in a −35°C medium (h=50 W/m²·K, ρ=1000, L=230 kJ/kg, k=1.5): ΔT=33.5°C and t≈81.0 min, which is ordinary freezing with large ice crystals, so raise the air speed or lower the temperature.
map.多久算速冻？: How long counts as quick freezing?
map.常以中心通过最大冰晶带（−1~−5℃）时间短、中心达 −18℃ 为准；t<30: It is judged by a short time for the centre to pass the maximum ice crystal zone (−1 to −5°C) and for the centre to reach −18°C; under 30 min is a good quick freeze.
map.形状系数怎么选？: How do I choose the shape factors?
map.按最小尺寸几何取 P、R；厚度 d 主导，减薄与提高 h（风速/温差）最能缩短时: Take P and R from the geometry of the smallest dimension; the thickness d dominates, so thinning the product and raising h (air speed and temperature difference) shorten the time most.
